**Windows only. Not a medical device** — treat from the official app and a meter.

Needs a LibreLinkUp follower account that already shows a reading in the LibreLinkUp phone app. FreeStyle Libre only.

1. Download `vr-cgm-overlay-<version>-windows.zip` below and **Extract All**.
2. Double-click `vr-cgm-overlay.exe` in the extracted folder.
3. Windows says "Windows protected your PC", because the program is not signed: **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
4. Sign in with your LibreLinkUp email and password.
5. For VR, start SteamVR; the face appears on your left controller.

Updating: delete the old folder and extract the new one. Settings live in `%APPDATA%\vr-cgm-overlay` and are kept.

Full instructions, including what has and has not been tested: [README](https://github.com/p-kitty/vr-cgm-overlay#download-for-windows).
